title: Advanced and Specialized Web Security
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Advanced and Specialized Web Security.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Advanced and Specialized Web Security topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
